title: The Art of Asking: Multilingual Prompt Optimization for Synthetic Data

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating 'translationese' (translation artifacts) and naturalness in multilingual text generation using perplexity scores, n-gram diversity metrics, and automated LLM judges, as well as comparing downstream performance disparities between high-resource/supported languages and low-resource/unsupported languages.

Comparing model accuracy on cultural-agnostic versus cultural-sensitive question subsets within the Global-MMLU benchmark, and evaluating downstream performance on culturally localized academic and professional exams (Include44) to measure English-centric framing.
